title: Use Inferlo's AI inside an Elysia app
prompt: Create src/elysia.ts for an existing ElysiaJS app. Export `elysia`, an Elysia app whose handlers get the AI client from the context as `ai`, put there by Inferlo's Elysia plugin. The AI client uses an Anthropic provider (API key from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable) with a "fast" alias for anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5. Add POST /translate to the Elysia app: it reads { "text": string, "to": string } from the JSON body, asks the "fast" model to translate the text into that language, and returns { "translation": <the model's text> }. Also mount the existing Inferlo app from src/app.ts under /api, so GET /api/health reaches its health endpoint.
